hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.intro: PubliX Group AB ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect through publixgroup.io, why we collect it, how long we keep it, and what rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

collect.p_form: When you submit the contact form we collect: name, email, company, message. Provided directly by you.
collect.p_news: When you subscribe we collect: email address. Provided directly by you.
collect.p_analytics: We use Google Analytics 4 for aggregated site-usage statistics (page views, referrers, country, device type). GA4 uses cookies (_ga, _ga_F39X0LXQTH) that are set only after you consent via our cookie banner. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set and no analytics data is collected. GA4 does not log or store full IP addresses; Google uses the IP only transiently to derive coarse geolocation and then discards it.
collect.p_logs: Our hosting provider Netlify records standard HTTP access logs (IP address, timestamp, requested URL, user agent) for security and abuse prevention. Retained per Netlify's data policy.

why.li1: Contact enquiries — Legitimate interest (responding to your request). Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
why.li2: Newsletter subscription — Consent (your explicit opt-in). Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. You can withdraw consent by unsubscribing at any time.
why.li3: Server logs — Legitimate interest (site security). Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

retain.li1: Contact enquiries: up to 24 months from last interaction
retain.li3: Server logs: per Netlify's retention (typically 30 days)
retain.li4: Analytics: only if you consent. GA4 cookies expire after 2 years; aggregated data retained per Google Analytics defaults.

processors.p: We use the following processors, each bound by GDPR data processing agreements:
processors.li1: Netlify, Inc. — website hosting and form submissions (US-based; EU-US Data Privacy Framework)
processors.li2: Google Ireland Limited — analytics (Ireland, EU). Sub-processor: Google LLC (United States, under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework). Only when you consent via our cookie banner.
processors.p2: We do not sell your data or share it with advertisers or marketing platforms.

rights.li1: Access the personal data we hold about you
rights.li3: Delete your data ("right to be forgotten")
rights.li4: Restrict or object to processing based on legitimate interest
rights.li5: Receive your data in a portable format
rights.li6: Withdraw consent at any time (for consent-based processing)
rights.li7: Lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority
rights.p2: To exercise any of these rights, email info@publixgroup.io. We will respond within 30 days.

changes.p: We may update this policy from time to time. The "last updated" date at the top will reflect the most recent change.
